plants.morphology: Small creeping exposed reddish rhizome with fine attachment roots. Nine short-petioled dark olive-green elongated oval leathery leaves, 4-6 cm long, wavy entire margins, tiny sparse pale dots. Compact low spreading asymmetrical epiphyte. Not broad heart-shaped Anubias and not a fern.

One compact basal rosette with ten lanceolate medium-green crinkled leaves on slender petioles; visibly hammered blade texture and gently wavy margins, mature leaves spread outward lower, young leaves more upright. Fine buried-root bundle at the crown, no exposed long creeping rhizome. Leaf length about 10-18 cm. Not fern leaflets or grass.

Basal rosette with nine long narrow strap-shaped hammered olive-green blades with strongly corrugated margins. Lengths vary 22-34 cm, widths 1.5-2.5 cm. Leaves rise in loose arcs, some twisting gently; visible crinkling across each blade. Rooted crown, not a creeping epiphyte or feather fern. No branched fronds.

Rooted basal crown with ten broad lanceolate sword leaves, vivid but restrained medium green, clear longitudinal midrib and parallel arching secondary veins. Longer inner leaves upright, older outer leaves spread in a full three-dimensional rosette. Blades 18-29 cm including petiole, width 3-5 cm. Smooth entire edges, no fern leaflets or strong corrugation, no horizontal rhizome.

Small dense rooted crown with eleven narrow light-green ribbon leaves of unequal length 6-12 cm, about 4-7 mm wide. Straight tapering entire blades with rounded-to-pointed tips and delicate longitudinal veins, outward arching older leaves, upright younger leaves. One short basal runner with a tiny daughter bud. Submerged ribbon form, NOT emergent arrow-shaped leaves or a broad-leaf fern.

One rooted rosette with ten long narrow grass-like ribbon leaves, 24-38 cm long and 5-10 mm wide. Longitudinal parallel veins and slightly rounded tapered tips. Medium-green leaves arch and softly twist, but are NOT tight corkscrew spirals: the species name does not imply every leaf is a corkscrew. No petiole/blade shoulder, no branched stems, no flowers.

Small brown basal tuber bearing nine translucent-looking but painted opaque light olive-green elongate leaves on narrow petioles. Blades have conspicuously wavy ruffled margins and fine cross-veins. Lengths 18-30 cm, blade width 2-4 cm. A few leaves bow outward, others upright. Correct single tuber base and root bundle; not a feather fern or a flat sword plant. No flowers or water surface.

Thick short rhizome with eight broad ovate leaves on individual petioles, blades 6-12 cm long and 4-8 cm wide. Dusty muted red-violet, copper-pink and olive-green patches with contrasting green veins, reddish undersides, one younger pink leaf. Unequal gently cupped blades and clear basal shoulders, no serrations or fern leaflets. Natural subdued red aquatic plant, not neon purple or a flowering terrestrial plant.

solids.shape: One low asymmetrical water-worn river boulder with an offset flattened dome, one shallow diagonal seam, small worn chips and broad rounded sides. Warm gray-brown stone with pale quartz streaks, subtle cool shadows. Broad footprint, length 30 cm, height 17 cm, depth 21 cm. Not a perfect sphere, no rock pile or foliage.

One broken upright basalt mass with three unequal naturally fractured shoulders, dark blue-charcoal stone, sparse lighter mineral edges and a blunt slanted broken top. Irregular chunky cross-section, not a regular hexagonal column or castle. Length 23 cm, height 30 cm, depth 20 cm. Grounded solid base, no vegetation or holes.

One low spreading weathered sandstone ledge with three tilted eroded strata, an off-center rounded upper shoulder and a chipped lower lip. Muted reddish ochre, dusty tan bands and cool umber recesses. Length 36 cm, height 17 cm, depth 23 cm. Real irregular layered rock, no arch holes or loose separate pebbles.

One pale cream-gray limestone mass with an uneven lobed footprint, two low rounded eroded ridges and shallow pitted surface. Warm ivory worn edges, cool gray fissures and a darker small scoop on one side. Length 27 cm, height 21 cm, depth 21 cm. No deep holes, no coral texture, no symmetrical crystal or rock pile.

One short old driftwood stump with a blunt broken upright trunk, a thick off-center root crotch and exactly three unequal flared supporting roots. Desaturated gray umber and warm honey exposed fibers, grain forks continuously through the crotch. Length 34 cm, height 29 cm, depth 26 cm. All roots thick and irregular, not cones or a starburst. No detached pieces, holes or leaves.

One long low S-curved driftwood limb with a thick twisted knot near the left third and one short blunt side spur. Flattened worn contact underside, irregular broken ends with visible fibers, flowing grain spirals through the knot. Muted gray-brown with pale weathered ridges. Length 46 cm, height 15 cm, depth 18 cm. No extra upright branches, no uniform cylindrical log, no leaves or holes.

One grounded flattened root fan with one thick central knotted base and exactly four uneven broad gnarled roots spreading left/right and forward, some overlapping in front elevation but clearly separated in top view. Dark coffee brown with restrained pale worn fibers. Length 40 cm, height 19 cm, depth 29 cm. Broad irregular organic roots, no evenly tapered spikes, no extra thin twigs, no leaves or loose parts.

One irregular low fallen log segment with partly peeled dark bark and a broad exposed gray-tan inner wood ridge, gently bowed rather than straight, one thick broken root nub at the left rear and splintered blunt ends. Length 38 cm, height 17 cm, depth 20 cm. Solid weathered wood with shallow natural scars, no through-holes, no perfect cylinder or geometric sawcut. Grain follows the curve, bark and exposed wood belong to the same object.
